reason: I like the idea, since I already read POS every Monday and run small store trials myself, but signing a 12-month contract for at least 10 stores, close to a million pesos, with a company that has zero customer results is not something I'd do. A simulation isn't real shoppers, and I have nothing yet showing its predictions match what actually happens on my floor.
objection: A simulation is not real shoppers. Why would I trust its predictions enough to lock in a year and 10 stores before I've seen it get even one of my own changes right?
would_change_my_mind: A short paid pilot on 2-3 of my stores with no 12-month lock-in, where StoreLab predicts the result of a layout change before we make it and the real POS numbers from test vs control stores confirm it.
